# AGENTS.md — 23-blog-newsletter

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **Marginalia**, blog & newsletter, style "Pocket paperback".
- Stack: Astro 7, MDX. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `src/content/essay.en.mdx` — English essay
- `src/content/essay.ru.mdx` — Russian essay
- `src/pages/index.astro` — cover, contents, page counter script
- `src/components/Fn.astro` — sidenote component
- `src/styles/global.css` — tokens at the top

## How to run
- `npm install          # Node 22.23+ (Astro 7)`
- `npm run dev`
- `npm run build   # ./dist`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: Margin footnotes (sidenotes) that become tap-to-open notes on phones + a page counter ('p. 9 of 18') instead of a progress bar.
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- One reading measure (~34rem); nothing competes with the text column.
- Orange only on the cover bands, drop cap, footnote numbers and the page counter.
- Posts are MDX; footnotes are <Fn n={…}> with the note as children.
- Small caps (Alegreya Sans SC) for furniture: running heads, labels, contents numbers.
- No tracking, no pop-up subscribe forms.

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
